eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; at 6:28 PM on AUG 28, 2025 Effective until 4:28 AM AUG 29, 2025. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. A Silver Alert has been issued for Navajo County. Navajo County Sheriffis looking for Michael Olen Johnson last seen leaving his residence driving his Honda Side by side. If you have contact with this Silver Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
